name: Tochi Mba
lede: I build production AI systems and the software around them: assistant hubs, workflow runtimes, the services that keep a person's data and secrets where they belong, and the desktop and mobile apps that make it all usable. First Class BSc Computer Science with Cybersecurity.
intro: I'm Tochi, and I go by Rex. I'm an AI engineer at Jigsaw Create in London, where I designed and built Jigsaw Intelligence: a multi-agent system that lets people query and change complex business diagrams in plain language.

Outside work I run REX Technologies, my own product line: the LUCY assistant and its family of services, the weftai workflow runtime on npm and PyPI, and desktop and mobile apps like Flint and Android Headless Mirror. I graduated with a First in Computer Science with Cybersecurity from the University of Huddersfield.
availability: Open to AI engineering and full-stack roles

howIWork.title: Small pieces, well tested, shipped.
howIWork.body: I split a system into small services that each own one job, write down the decisions that matter, and keep the same checks in every repository so none of them drifts. I would rather ship something smaller that works than something bigger that almost does.

points.title: Models get data, never instructions.
points.body: Whatever a person or a web page says reaches the model as a claim with its source, so a stray instruction in an email cannot steer it.

points.title: Safety comes before polish.
points.body: When a service can run code or hold a credential, its boundaries are built and tested first, and the interface after.

points.title: The same checks everywhere.
points.body: Lint, types and tests at full branch coverage in every repository, held by CI, so a change anywhere is held to the same bar.
